description:
Render a KPI scorecard (card grid) from already-fetched summary data. Call this when a tool
response includes render_with="render-scorecard": pass the same numbers through, do not
summarise them in prose. Values are RAW numbers (e.g. 1234567, not "1.2M"); the widget
formats them. unit is "$" (prefix), "%" (suffix) or "s" (a duration like 687 -> "11m 27s").
Money is a raw decimal in the account currency (not cents). Use group to section cards when
there are more than 4. Pass source={tool, params} to render an "Open in SEOcrawl" deep link.

Cost: free.

Examples:
```json
// KPI scorecard built from a get_gsc_summary response (raw numbers passed through).
{"title":"GSC summary","cards":[{"label":"Clicks","value":5432,"change":{"value":13.1,"direction":"up"}},{"label":"Avg position","value":8.5}]}
```

cards.description: KPI cards. Each: label (required), value (raw number; omit/null = N/A), unit ("$"|"%"|"s"), change {value: positive %, direction "up"|"down"}, group (section header).

source.description: Optional deep link target. tool = the bare data-tool name that produced this data; params = its arguments.

params.description: The source tool's arguments, passed through verbatim. Include property so a deep link can be built.

title.description: Heading shown above the card grid.

name: render-scorecard
title: KPI scorecard
